WF-01 · Monarch Stickman Animation — HUB
Google Docs hub of workflow WF-01 in MONARCH STUDIO · created 2026-10-09 (turn 15) · status PARKED by the user after turn 13 · resume key “best video reel editing”


Identity
Workflow code WF-01. Name “Monarch Stickman Animation” (before 2026-10-09 the Notion page and Linear project carried the name without the WF prefix; same objects, renamed). Style: Monarch stickman motion-edit — paper/ink Style B, 1080×1920 vertical shorts (−11.6 LUFS, something new on screen every 2–3 s) and 16:9 films (120–300 s, −16.5 LUFS, holds 7–14 s); Python renderer (src/clean.py, src/toon.py 3D rig, src/shade.py + src/hybrid.py for SHADE, the user’s hooded black-suit hero in the hybrid look), extruded type, varied 3D cinematic transitions (tint-not-flood, end on the beat), ASMR bed with varied premium SFX, chrome; measured not eyeballed — 19 gates (src/gate_respect2.py) + gate #20 (brain/concept.py gate). Mindset = MONARCH EDITOR BRAIN v2 (MONARCH_EDITOR_BRAIN.md §0–§14 + brain/): every new video is proposed, picked, built, gated, uploaded and committed through the brain ritual, and must differ from the previous ones (hook/device rest 3, grammar/camera/sonic/type/ending rest 2, transitions overlap ≤ .40 with ≥ 3 new kinds, SFX ≥ 50 % new).

Standing rules for any return
Measured not eyeballed; deliverables on Drive with md5 in the same turn; everything recorded (RESUME_STATE.md, session log, Notion Doc 00 callout, Linear MON-34 STATE comment, this document’s Current state); Roman Urdu concise replies with ids. Identity stays (v9 vertical pipeline, extruded type, SHADE 3D-rig hero, hybrid look, transitions, ASMR bed, chrome) — each new edit different from the last (brain gate #20). Safe area y 180–1500, contrast ≥ 4.5:1, tint-not-flood transitions, nothing perfectly still, voice centred / bed wide, mix never breathes out, premium is subtraction; natural VO pauses (no big inter-chapter gaps), no continuous static bed, no SFX repeated over and over, no repeated transitions. Rejected: flat chalk stickman, high element density, mitten hands, mono SFX.

A tactile bone-paper and ink world with the locked hooded SHADE Monarch, split timelines, punched-paper time, hand-built type, print-registration texture, and one yellow seat as the earned visual resolution. V2 CREATIVE REDESIGN
The tactile paper/ink/SHADE identity is retained, but the stage is rebuilt as three simultaneous motion planes: story action, physical depth/parallax and continuous micro-motion. Six camera-control modes, 12 motivated transition families, live paper cards, perspective guides, kinetic HUD states, light sweeps and deterministic print texture now carry every beat. Density is hierarchical rather than noisy.


FIVE EARNED SET PIECES
1. The question-mark seat becomes a nine-layer ticket aperture with orbiting paper shards.
2. The dopamine feed collapses into a chromatic optical card tunnel.
3. Thirty ticket holes physically extrude into a rising 3-D thirty-hour graph.
4. “LEKIN SACH?” tears the paper world open into a black/red truth portal.
5. Graph points become thirty train windows as rails fold under the final Monarch walk.
